Profiles change available CPU, GPU, VM and I/O controls immediately. Gaming can increase heat and battery use. Nodes vary by device; partial changes are possible. Nothing is applied automatically.

Restoring uses the saved values even if another tool changed them since. Only current-boot snapshots are used. Some nodes may fail to restore.

Boost writes supported network or mixer values only after confirmation. Originals are recorded before each first write, for this boot only. Partial failure and external changes are reported; restoration is not guaranteed.

Detect legacy 3.x/2.x startup scripts without changing them

This removes only the four known Synthetica/rc Boost startup script paths. It does not undo past settings or stop a script already running. Older versions did not save all original values, so those cannot be recovered automatically.
